text:
elaine: Quick sync — we need a tight launch post + webinar narrative that ties our benchmark to the 'Serving not owning' positioning. Goal: MQLs + give SDRs a replayable playbook. Webinar target 2024-05-12. Thoughts?
rob: Love it. Make the benchmark visual — p50/p95 latency, cost per token, throughput. Short headline stat for the hero.
sunita: I'll draft a 1-pg battlecard. Include a 'When to pick Redwood vs cloud' table (cost/token, latency, SLA, private deploy), plus 3 short objection handlers.
kevin: Routing note — when webinar registrant tags enterprise -> AE queue; otherwise SDR nurture. Also need GDPR/EU routing.
mike-sdr: ++. Need two email templates (pre-webinar invite, post-webinar playbook). CTAs: 'Request dedicated trial' and 'See private deployment case study'.
aria-bot: (upload) benchmark CSV available -> https://storage.redwood/benchmarks/serving_vs_cloud_2024.csv
elaine: Sunita, top-line stats to include in hero: p50 latency 95ms (Redwood) vs 210ms (cloud); cost/token $0.0009 vs $0.0028; steady throughput 4k tok/s per GPU vs 2k tok/s. Keep numbers rounded.
sunita: Got it. Drafting now. Will add short lead scripts for SDRs.
rob: For the webinar slide deck: one-liner idea — 'Predictable inference economics: same API, better unit economics, enterprise controls.' Keep it punchy.
mike-sdr: HubSpot routing pseudo-rule below — will implement/QA with kevin:
```
if job_title in ["CTO","Head of ML","Infrastructure Lead"] or company_size > 500 -> assign AE_team
else if lead_score >= 65 -> SDR_priority
else -> nurture_automated_sequence
```
kevin: Add geo routing: EU leads -> EU SDR queue; SLA = 24h response. Also flag regulated industries for private-deploy follow-up.
elaine: Marketing deliverables checklist: launch post, 1-pg battlecard, 6-slide webinar deck, benchmark appendix, 2 email templates, SDR playbook, SE one-pager. Who owns what?
sunita: I'll take battlecard + objection bullets. ETA first draft: tomorrow EOD. I'll ping product for technical sign-off.
rob: Webinar demo idea: short live compare — show latency graph + brief QPS test. Keep demo <6 minutes.
mike-sdr: Rebut line for "we already use cloud provider":
"Cloud providers standardize compute. Redwood standardizes serving — giving teams predictable latency, lower unit costs, and built-in fallbacks for reliability across model variants and regions."
sunita: Shortening for SDR use: 3 bullets under 'Objections' section.
kevin: I'll draft the HubSpot flow and share screenshots. Also will add tags for routing: #enterprise, #gdpr-eu, #regulated.
aria-bot: Reminder: final benchmark CSV scheduled upload at 1749998900.
mike-sdr: Noted — I'll prep the email templates and the SDR scripts. Want 3-click rebut snippets for discovery calls.
elaine: Assignments: @sunita battlecard, @rob slides and demo script, @mike-sdr routing + SDR playbook + templates, @kevin HubSpot flows, @product for benchmark validation. Check-in in 24h. :thumbsup: 
sunita: First draft live: https://notion.redwood/marketing/battleroom/serving-vs-cloud/draft — will update after product review.
elaine: Great work team. We'll iterate on copytone (less infra-jargon, more econ + reliability). Thanks!
